title: Body families, proportions, and identity preservation
plainLanguage: The same skeleton can describe characters with different proportions. A character should not be stretched to fit another character just because their joint names match.
purpose: Support endless compatible characters while preserving each character family’s recognizable proportions.

rules.statement: Store body-family identity separately from skeleton version.
Cross-character matching may compare normalized pose shape, but applying motion or parts must preserve target proportions unless an explicit authored transform says otherwise.
A part compatibility claim is valid only for body families or proportion ranges that were actually tested.

implementation.currentSupport: Corpus Pane records a compatible bodyType/body-family label.
implementation.futureWork: Define tested body-family ranges for poser parts and retargeting.
